scope: Public-neutral faculty contracts derived from the D-ND workspace; no private state, credentials, runtime topology, or external authority is transferred.

bundle_definitions.foundation: Orientation, faculty routing, safety, topology, continuity, and learning.
bundle_definitions.software: Diagnosis, architecture, repository setup, node capability transfer, and recovery.
bundle_definitions.design: UX, agentic interaction, design systems, communication surfaces, and learning from demonstrations.
bundle_definitions.research: Evidence intake, scenarios, archives, laboratories, media, and critical-factor control.
bundle_definitions.product: Capability productization, client setup, business movement, editorial work, and operating-form decisions.
bundle_definitions.interaction: Delegation, external review, browser work, conversational surfaces, and personal workflows.
bundle_definitions.operations: Mutation control, runtime work, publication, synchronization, and recovery.

result_contracts.agentic-ux: A state-aware interaction model with visible intent, progress, action, recovery, and accessibility checks.
result_contracts.business-routing: A classified business lane, selected owner, evidence boundary, useful next move, and explicit non-actions.
result_contracts.cognitive-delegation: A source-bounded delegation packet and an integration review that preserves local decision authority.
result_contracts.autoevolutive-projects: The smallest additive reentry and evolution scaffold, with sources, state, first safe action, and validation.
result_contracts.deep-module-design: A stable interface, hidden policy boundary, dependency direction, migration seam, and focused tests.
result_contracts.failure-diagnosis: A reproduction, ranked hypotheses, discriminating evidence, verified mechanism, and regression proof.
result_contracts.ai-capability-productization: A capability-to-product map with user, proof, package, delivery boundary, maturity, and next test.
result_contracts.business-portfolio-management: A bounded business decision capsule with positioning, evidence, opportunity, risk, and next action.
result_contracts.client-setup-orchestration: A transferable setup packet with context, sources, requested result, artifacts, gates, and handoff receipt.
result_contracts.capability-node-sync: A source/destination comparison, portable delta, excluded state, validation plan, and synchronization receipt.
result_contracts.community-contribution: A selected contribution opportunity, source-backed draft, review state, send boundary, and learning receipt.
result_contracts.design-element-routing: A justified pattern and primitive selection tied to user task, state, hierarchy, responsive behavior, and constraints.
result_contracts.demonstration-learning: An observation record, inferred method, uncertainty, competence candidate, evaluation, and application gate.
result_contracts.research-lab-operations: A project-local experiment or operation plan with inputs, runtime boundary, deterministic evidence, and receipt.
result_contracts.operational-noise-control: A smaller decisive source set, residue classification, preserved evidence, and lower-cost next action.
result_contracts.source-integrity-interference-guard: A frozen source, instruction-layer inventory, evidence of additions or losses, finite alert, owner-gated cleanup proposal, and reopen condition.
result_contracts.possibility-horizon: A scenario map with signals, branches, impacts, options, reversible preparations, and evidence triggers.
result_contracts.repository-observation: A read-only repository diagnosis and minimal retrofit proposal with sources, gaps, boundaries, and first safe move.
result_contracts.public-surface-publication: A reviewed artifact, target binding, publication gate, expected live effect, verification plan, and delivery receipt.
result_contracts.skill-evolution: A reusable delta classified to its correct owner, with source, trigger, proof, compatibility, and evolution receipt.
result_contracts.capability-level-routing: A placement decision across residue, state, template, skill, metaskill, project rule, Seed, or product.
result_contracts.conversational-surface: A conversation-layer diagnosis or design with context, reasoning, tool, action, privacy, and recovery boundaries.
result_contracts.system-topology: An entity and relation map with roles, state providers, write owners, drift, parity gaps, and bounded evolution proposal.
result_contracts.ux-engineering: An implementable UI contract with hierarchy, states, responsive rules, accessibility, motion, and visual QA evidence.
result_contracts.editorial-writing: A source-faithful artifact with reader movement, claim classes, revision notes, material boundary, and available action.
result_contracts.external-review: A review packet, returned-proposal assessment, accepted and rejected deltas, evidence gaps, and local next action.
result_contracts.intent-first-coordination: A resultant-first packet with intent, context, roles, sources, non-actions, quality gates, and return receipt.
result_contracts.recovery-continuity: A recovery-surface assessment, freshness evidence, restore sequence, protected configuration list, and reentry receipt.
result_contracts.autological-ux: A journey from bounded intake to one consequential choice, effect preview, recoverable action, and inspectable result.
result_contracts.research-business-boundary: A research-to-value translation with protected scientific claims, viable offer forms, evidence, and realization gates.
result_contracts.critical-factor-control: A prioritized factor map with performance dimensions, risks, horizons, faculty owners, and validation cadence.
result_contracts.operating-form: A current-form statement with stable nucleus, verified present, selected direction, boundaries, and next owner.
result_contracts.semantic-bridge: A simplifying semantic relation with preserved identities, scope, non-equivalences, downstream uses, and failure test.
result_contracts.communication-design: A public communication contract aligning product truth, copy, hierarchy, navigation, metadata, actions, and review gate.
result_contracts.personal-workflow-administration: A private obligation and evidence summary, drafted response or plan, missing data, deadlines, and no-send boundary.
result_contracts.meta-skill-routing: A faculty architecture with entity, plane, role, relation, mutation, gate, receipt, and reusable delta placement.
result_contracts.meta-skill-presence: A compact cross-surface check that prevents identity, authority, state, source, and execution from being fused.
result_contracts.browser-assistance: A verified browser-surface snapshot, source/destination distinction, staged action, submission gate, and visible-state receipt.
result_contracts.archive-retrieval: A bounded source digest with provenance, reusable mechanism, present-authority limit, destination, and promotion decision.
result_contracts.runtime-node-operations: A verified node and service map, intended operation, risk class, commands or checks, rollback, and runtime receipt.
result_contracts.mutation-routine: A pre-mutation gate plus the smallest reusable procedure, script, manifest, checklist, or explicit no-routine decision.
result_contracts.curated-media-intelligence: A source-quality assessment, extracted signal, project relevance, evidence need, residue filter, and promotion level.
result_contracts.youtube-transcript-intake: A transcript-backed signal card with source quality, extracted mechanism, project delta, boundary, and promotion proposal.
result_contracts.observer-kernel: An observation capsule covering entities, planes, roles, relations, state, uncertainty, mutation, gates, and useful resultant.

faculties.title: Agentic UX
faculties.public_function: Design human-AI workspaces that expose state, intent, progress, recovery, and action boundaries.

faculties.title: Business Routing
faculties.public_function: Distinguish strategy, offer, partnership, outreach, communication, and product work before choosing an action.

faculties.title: Cognitive Delegation
faculties.public_function: Prepare bounded packets for another model or agent and reintegrate the returned work without transferring authority.

faculties.title: Autoevolutive Project Setup
faculties.public_function: Add reentry, source, state, semantic-kernel, evidence, and memory-delta layers to a repository without replacing its native structure.

faculties.title: Deep Module Design
faculties.public_function: Shape a small stable interface that hides dependency policy and change complexity behind a coherent seam.

faculties.title: Software Failure Diagnosis
faculties.public_function: Diagnose bugs and regressions through reproduction, ranked falsifiable hypotheses, discriminating probes, and regression proof.

faculties.title: AI Capability Productization
faculties.public_function: Turn a demonstrated capability into a reviewable product, proof, package, service, or integration path without overclaiming.

faculties.title: Business And Portfolio Management
faculties.public_function: Coordinate positioning, offers, partnerships, portfolio evidence, opportunity review, and bounded next business actions.

faculties.title: Client Setup Orchestration
faculties.public_function: Convert an ambiguous client or product request into a transferable setup packet with sources, boundaries, artifacts, gates, and next actions.

faculties.title: Capability Node Synchronization
faculties.public_function: Compare and transfer reusable capability packages between agent nodes without cloning local state, secrets, or identity.

faculties.title: Community Contribution
faculties.public_function: Select, draft, review, and learn from useful public contributions while keeping posting and sending explicitly supervised.

faculties.title: Design Element Routing
faculties.public_function: Choose suitable interface patterns and primitives from a design seed before composing a new surface.

faculties.title: Learning From Demonstration
faculties.public_function: Transform observed interaction and correction into a bounded competence candidate, implementation delta, and evaluation plan.

faculties.title: Research Lab Operations
faculties.public_function: Operate a computational research surface through project-local authority, deterministic receipts, and explicit runtime gates.

faculties.title: Operational Noise Control
faculties.public_function: Reduce context entropy, duplicate state, generated residue, and repeated decision cost while preserving decisive evidence.

faculties.title: Source Integrity Interference Guard
faculties.public_function: Preserve exact source and expose instruction-layer interference, silent normalization, authority drift, and reversible cleanup boundaries.

faculties.title: Possibility Horizon
faculties.public_function: Turn uncertainty into observable signals, scenario branches, risks, reversible preparations, and capability gaps.

faculties.title: Repository Observation And Setup
faculties.public_function: Inspect an existing repository and propose a non-invasive continuity, evidence, source, state, and semantic-kernel retrofit.

faculties.title: Public Surface Publication
faculties.public_function: Prepare and verify public content changes while separating editorial approval, repository writes, publication, and live verification.

faculties.title: Skill Evolution
faculties.public_function: Capture reusable corrections as bounded skill, state, template, or capability updates with an owner, proof, and receipt.

faculties.title: Capability Level Routing
faculties.public_function: Decide whether a lesson belongs as residue, state, trigger, skill, metaskill, project rule, public seed, or product capability.

faculties.title: Conversational Surface Control
faculties.public_function: Diagnose and evolve a public or administrative AI conversation while separating page context, reasoning, tools, and external actions.

faculties.title: System Topology Evolution
faculties.public_function: Keep nodes, applications, providers, repositories, roles, and competence ownership distinct while detecting drift and parity gaps.

faculties.title: UX And Interface Engineering
faculties.public_function: Design and review frontend systems for hierarchy, accessibility, responsive behavior, state legibility, motion, and cross-surface coherence.

faculties.title: Editorial Writing
faculties.public_function: Recover source truth, shape reader movement, discipline claims, write, revise, subtract, and preserve reusable editorial learning.

faculties.title: External Frontier Review
faculties.public_function: Prepare a high-leverage review packet for another capable model and validate returned proposals against local truth and boundaries.

faculties.title: Intent-First Agent Coordination
faculties.public_function: Describe the intended resultant, context, sources, roles, gates, and receipt so another agent can act without inheriting hidden authority.

faculties.title: Recovery Continuity
faculties.public_function: Assess backup and recovery surfaces, preserve change reasons, plan restore work, and keep reentry evidence current.

faculties.title: Autological UX
faculties.public_function: Guide unfamiliar users from bounded context to one consequential decision, visible authority, recoverable action, and inspectable result.

faculties.title: Research-To-Business Boundary
faculties.public_function: Translate frontier research into support, pilots, offers, or distribution without reducing the research to marketing claims.

faculties.title: Critical Factor Control
faculties.public_function: Track critical factors, performance dimensions, possibility horizons, and competence routing across a multilayer project.

faculties.title: Operating Form Clarification
faculties.public_function: Clarify what a changing system currently is, why it exists, what it is becoming, and which boundary owns the next action.

faculties.title: Semantic Bridge
faculties.public_function: Use productive ambiguity to connect related concepts and layers while keeping identities, repositories, and authority distinct.

faculties.title: Public Communication Design
faculties.public_function: Bind public copy, visual hierarchy, navigation, metadata, maturity, and available actions to one verified product truth.

faculties.title: Personal Workflow Administration
faculties.public_function: Reconcile private messages, documents, obligations, evidence, and draft replies without silently sending, paying, moving, or deleting.

faculties.title: Meta-Skill Routing
faculties.public_function: Architect and route faculties, competences, project kernels, public capability packages, update candidates, and receipts.

faculties.title: Meta-Skill Presence
faculties.public_function: Keep entity, role, relation, mutation, authority, and receipt distinctions present when a task crosses capabilities or surfaces.

faculties.title: Browser Assistance
faculties.public_function: Orient within a selected browser surface, distinguish source from destination, and stage actions without submitting them implicitly.

faculties.title: Archive And Metaprompt Retrieval
faculties.public_function: Retrieve bounded source material from an archive, distill reusable mechanisms, and route them without turning archival text into present authority.

faculties.title: Runtime Node Operations
faculties.public_function: Inspect and operate a remote or local runtime only after verifying node identity, project owner, service boundary, and side-effect gate.

faculties.title: Mutation And Routine Guard
faculties.public_function: Classify the target, authority, reversibility, validation, and receipt before mutation, then extract repeated work into the smallest useful routine.

faculties.title: Curated Media Intelligence
faculties.public_function: Evaluate curated media streams as weak signals, compare them with project needs, and preserve only evidence-backed deltas.

faculties.title: YouTube Transcript Intake
faculties.public_function: Extract a transcript before analysis, assess source quality, and convert useful content into a low-noise signal or promotion proposal.

faculties.title: Observer Kernel
faculties.public_function: Observe entities, planes, roles, relations, state, uncertainty, mutation, gates, and receipts before selecting a bounded resultant.
